items.title: 27.3.1 Enzyme ki sargarmi par asar andaz amil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the factors affecting enzyme activity (PDF 168).

blocks.text: Enzyme ki sargarmi par zyada tar darja hararat, pH aur substrate aur enzyme ke concentrations asar karte hain; co-enzymes, activators aur inhibitors jaise doosre maadde bhi asar kar sakte hain.

items: Darja hararat aur pH: jo darja hararat aur pH sab se zyada sargarmi dete hain woh optimum temperature aur optimum pH hain. In qeematon se hatna enzyme ko ghair fa'aal kar sakta hai (us ki shakal badal jati hai). Insani jism ke enzymes taqreeban 37 C par behtareen kaam karte hain; kitab pH ki had 6.4-6.9 deti hai, halanke kuch enzymes, jaise maide ka pepsin, bohat mukhtalif pH par behtareen kaam karte hain.

Enzyme aur substrate ka concentration: enzyme ya substrate ka concentration barhne se raftaar barhti hai, kyunke zyada jorne ki jagahein use hoti aur zyada enzyme-substrate complex banta hai. Lekin substrate ke aik khaas concentration ke baad raftaar barhna ruk jati hai (kitab kehti hai ke ghat bhi sakti hai), kyunke active sites pehle se bhari hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Raftaar ke teen khaaka graph. Darja hararat: raftaar optimum (taqreeban 37 C) par chotti tak barh kar phir girti hai. pH: raftaar optimum pH par chotti tak barh kar phir girti hai. Substrate concentration: raftaar tezi se barh kar phir hamwar ho jati hai.
blocks.caption: Darja hararat, pH aur substrate concentration enzyme ki sargarmi par kaise asar karte hain (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Garmi optimum tak takkaron ko tez karti hai; us se oopar enzyme ki shakal khatam hoti aur raftaar tezi se girti hai. Har enzyme ka optimum pH bhi hai. Zyada substrate se raftaar barhti hai jab tak taqreeban har active site masroof na ho, phir mazeed substrate se kam farq parta hai.

blocks.prompt: Zyada darja hararat par enzyme kaam karna kyun chhor deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Garmi us ki 3D shakal thaamne wale bonds torti hai, is liye active site ki shakal badal jati (enzyme denature hota) aur substrate fit nahi hota.

items: Optimum darja hararat (insaanon mein taqreeban 37 C) aur optimum pH.
Zyada enzyme ya substrate: tez, jab tak active sites bhar na jayein.
